known: Published aggregate findings and source Methods have been read. No individual PSI or inclusion/exclusion count values have been inspected. The March GEO table and April repository junction revision must not be silently mixed.
stage: Sequence, annotation and measurement-schema audit only
source: GSE307247 processed table SHA256 c5ec382ce6a54097fe15eda70a5738f891dbe831fab5242cf5ff3671f3c2cd07; author repository 67791aa433bf66ac0b7b095ede01d650c5de9cb1
permitted_columns: Reference, event_id, gene_exon, snp, source, seq_type, intron1, exon, intron2, full_seq, transcript_id, exon_start_hg38, exon_end_hg38, variant_hg38. Read count/PSI columns remain unopened except their names and published definitions.
sequence_rules: Construct full_seq must equal intron1+exon+intron2 and be 161 ACGT bases.
Group by exact reference background, exon boundaries and transcript; verify two distinct SNP differences and both single intermediates by sequence, not labels alone.
A native synonymous designation requires an exact coding frame from the specified annotation and unchanged codon translations; exonic status or length divisible by three is insufficient.
First audit complete internal codons; boundary-spanning codons require additional adjacent-exon sequence and remain excluded from that restricted design.
Check both source-version annotation consistency and physical insert identity. Retain counts for every exclusion.
Distinguish the native peptide from any reporter translation frame. Do not infer equal reporter proteins from native annotation alone.

decision_gates.measurement: At least two identified biological replicates in a common cell line, coherent WT comparison and counts/uncertainty semantics.

validation_plan_if_eligible: Gene-level sequence-only split; all exons and mutants of a gene stay together. Remove exact or near-identical cassette backgrounds across groups before fitting. Require a separate outcome protocol and committed design table before reading phenotype columns.
failure: Report the inference level the data support. Do not weaken count/independence criteria or choose a cell line from favorable outcomes. No claim of RNA structural mechanism without relevant comparator information.
